text:
ravi (PM): Rapid sync requested by FinanceBank: they need tenant-controlled keys (BYOK) + an immutable 5-year audit evidence lane limited to audit_logs and evidence blobs. Also asked for a clear emergency retention-extension path. Thoughts?

 dana (security): BYOK ok for pilot if keys stay customer-owned (we proxy calls). Required: KMS attestation checklist, signed export manifest, and recordable approval flows. Legal hold semantics must override auto-deletes.

 ben (eng-infra): Implementation sketch: add retention tiers "default:90d", "extended:1y", "archival:5y". Archive stored as cold objects with metadata kept for export indexing only. API: PATCH /tenants/:id/retention {"tier":"archival","scopes":["audit_logs","evidence"]} (support-only for pilot).

 zoe (ops): Escape hatch proposal: support ticket with 2 approvals (SRE + customer admin signature), temporary extension <=30 days, auto-revert scheduled, record signed-approval hash into audit stream before change.

 hannah (sales): Customer prefers a Console toggle, but will take pilot (support-only) if we show timeline and attestation. They want a procurement-ready one-pager and pricing cap option for first 12 months.

 ticket-bot: ticket #9001 created for FinanceBank BYOK pilot onboarding. status: awaiting-runbook.

 ravi (PM): MVP (pilot): manual BYOK onboarding, support-only retention flips (<=30d), exportable evidence bundles with sha256 checksums and signed manifest, onboarding fee + per-GB/month archival billing, legal_hold flag. Gates: security attestation, legal signoff, ops runbook, cost estimate.

 dana (security): Gate note: no BYOK GA until attestation + legal ok. For pilot, we require customer-signed attestation and HSM evidence if requested.

 ben (eng-infra): Risk: searchability on 5y archive limited. Recommend export-first model for full-content access. I'll deliver storage cost estimate and a sample export CLI by EOW.

 zoe (ops): Action: write runbook checklist for verify-keystore-ownership, record approval hash, run export, verify checksums, and on-call steps. Due Wed.

 hannah (sales): I'll draft the procurement one-pager after PM posts manifest template.

 ravi (PM): Ok locking in Q2 pilot (support-only), Q3 aim for Console self-serve if gates pass. I'll create the feature ticket and assign owners. Thanks.
